verdict.rationale: cubic's own documented review features touch parts of this story. It finds bugs in PRs and codebase scans, lets developers ask chat about selected code with codebase context, generates fixes, and can auto-resolve findings once the issue is fixed, which is a limited form of fix verification. It is a static review tool, though, and nothing shows it reproducing issues or running a root-cause investigation. missing for 10: issue reproduction (running or replaying failing behavior), a guided root-cause narrowing workflow, execution-based fix verification such as running tests, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: Enable automatic thread resolution to close findings when the issue is fixed
cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
